{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the correlation using pandas .corr() method directly, which uses pairwise deletion by default
# This will confirm the behavior
pearson_corr_pairwise = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins['body_mass_g'])

# Also compute listwise deletion for comparison
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])
pearson_corr_listwise = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Print both values
print(f"Pearson correlation (pairwise deletion): {pearson_corr_pairwise}")
print(f"Pearson correlation (listwise deletion): {pearson_corr_listwise}")"}
